format: Supplied trained PyTorch checkpoint, legacy serialization, unchanged
export: Colab training notebook produced an app-compatible native .pt (unfused, CPU float32, pickle protocol 2, legacy serialization); no additional conversion for deployment
module_methods: Inference-only adaptation of Ultralytics 8.4.56 for this checkpoint
source: User-supplied Desktop/holocube_transmitter.pt on 2026-11-06; identical to holocube_transmitter.pt in the Drive export bundle transmitter_pyramid_1323frames_20261106_20261107_043246_093158
class_definition: The black inverted pyramid (hologram prism) hanging inside the transmitter's cube frame. The frame, mounting bracket, and overhead rail are outside the box. Earlier checkpoints (through HoloCube 0.7) boxed the whole assembly instead.

training_metrics.note: Ultralytics validation at 320 px on the dataset's own time-block splits (same room and rig); best-F1 precision/recall; not a new-scene benchmark

validation: Three validation-split transmitter frames (bright, angled, low light) compared against independent Ultralytics inference; not an accuracy benchmark

intended_dataset.source_video: HoloCube_Unified_Landscape.mp4: three Quest recordings joined, 1280 x 720, 30 fps, every 3rd frame; two bright-room clips and one dark-room clip with the pyramid lit
intended_dataset.labels: Semi-automatic: one hand-drawn seed box, an object tracker, then two rounds of YOLO26n self-training; about 100 frames spot-checked visually; the archive's REVIEW.txt lists 92 low-confidence frames
intended_dataset.note: Prepared in this project on 2026-11-06 and used to train this checkpoint in the Colab notebook, so the metrics above come from its own splits.
